title: Invariants of a rewritten circuit
statement: For natural numbers $n,c$, a gate predicate $P$, an original gate list $G$, and a state $(H,m)$ consisting of rewritten gates and a vertex-index list, the rewrite invariant requires all of the following: $m$ has length $n+|G|$; each entry of $m$ at an index below $n+|G|$ is a valid vertex of $H$; $H$ is acyclic on $n$ inputs; and, for every Boolean assignment to those inputs, the value at each such mapped vertex equals the value at the corresponding vertex after evaluating $G$. It also requires that each mapped vertex's depth in $H$ is at most $c$ times the corresponding original depth, that $|H|$ is at most the sum over gates of their arities plus two, and that every gate in $H$ satisfies $P$.
hypotheses_covered: A rewrite state consisting of a gate list $H$ and natural-number list $m$
Rewritten gates are acyclic on $n$ inputs
Value preservation for every Boolean input assignment and every original vertex index below $n+|G|$
Depth bound by $c$ times the original vertex depth at every such index
Rewritten gate count is at most the sum of original arities plus two per gate
